systems.country_label: PDI2T Phase 2; national high-speed broadband network
systems.owner: Government of Benin / ADN (Agence pour le Développement du Numérique)
systems.tiers: Densifies the 2,000 km fibre backbone of Phase 1 (2016-2021) and extends fibre to additional municipalities; loan agreement of RMB 265 million signed 14 September 2021. No commune office is said to be on it.

note: Deal record for a backbone loan; fibre is extended to additional municipalities as places, with no local government office said to be connected.
